read.thesis: Lennar cut starts and sales pace to 3.7 and 4.0 per community while holding ~14% incentives; Q4 gross margin fell to 17.0% from 22.1%, and FY26 deliveries guided to ~85,000 with Q1 margin 15–16%.

triggers.label: Incentives ~14%; ASP down 10% YoY
triggers.quote: we maintained approximately 14% in incentives and price adjustments, while continuing to focus on volume

triggers.label: Starts pace cut to 3.7 per community
triggers.quote: we strategically reduced our starts and sales pace to 3.7 and 4.0 homes per community per month

triggers.label: Inventory turn improved to 2.2x
triggers.quote: our inventory turn improved to 2.2 times, supporting both operational efficiency and affordability

triggers.label: Q4 gross margin 22.1% → 17.0%
triggers.quote: compared to $2.1 billion, or 22.1%, in the fourth quarter of 2024

guidance.quote: we expect to deliver between 17,000 and 18,000 homes

guidance.metric: Q1 FY26 gross margin on home sales
guidance.quote: between 15% to 16% depending on market conditions
We expect our average sales price will be between $365,000 and $375,000

guidance.metric: Q1 FY26 SG&A % of home sales

guidance.quote: We expect that deliveries for the full year will be approximately 85,000 homes.

red_flags.label: Gross margin down 5 pts YoY on incentives
red_flags.quote: compared to $2.1 billion, or 22.1%, in the fourth quarter of 2024

red_flags.label: Q4 net earnings down ~55% YoY
red_flags.quote: compared to $1.1 billion, or $4.06 per diluted share in the fourth quarter of 2024
